problems.title: A discount for a big order was not given
paragraphs: The contract gives a 7% discount on orders of 30 or more items. This order has 45 items, so the discount applies.
The invoice does not show this discount.

problems.title: The payment deadline is shorter than agreed
paragraphs: The contract gives the buyer 28 days to pay after the invoice date. This invoice is dated 20 March 2027 and asks for payment by 3 April 2027, which is only 14 days.
The buyer should have until 17 April 2027.
This one does not change the amount to pay.
